assertions.evidence: The root explicitly loaded the generated interrogate Skill and all four packaged references.
The verdict retained the exact intent and source SHA-256 80bf5704a0bcc57ee05b4143aea6b5bc258c45bf3c7a4d1a2264829cfcf99669.

Both reviewers received the same frozen packet and no peer findings.
The root captured complete R1 and R2 results without reviewer follow-up or replacement.
A distinct synthesizer child started only after R1 and R2 were frozen.
The synthesis and final verdict attributed both concrete findings to R1 and R2.
The root executed cases for partial strings, non-string inputs, symbols, and values below and above the allowed range.
No runtime-produced child model identity was available, and the verdict explicitly reported model identity unavailable and diversity unproven.

limitations: Generated custom roles were not selectable on this CLI surface, so reviewer and synthesizer contracts were supplied inline.

The root performed an unnecessarily broad filename-only search for AGENTS.md under temporary directories; it did not read or modify those external matches, but future fixtures should constrain this lookup to repository ancestors.
Unrelated configured MCP startup warnings did not participate in the review.
